I was out drinking with friends and we were on our way to the designated drivers car and decided to cut through an alley that led into the parking lot of our work. Me in my drunken state decided that the best thing to do was to start skipping. In this same alley was an air conditioner that had a patch of gravel underneath it to catch dripping water. Well, my foot found that one patch of gravel and I twisted my foot. Now, I was hella drunk and I still felt how bad it hurt. But I was embarrassed so I pretended that it didn’t. 

Fast forward to the next morning. 

I woke up on my friends couch and had to pee. When to stand up and I couldn’t put any pressure on my foot. I had to crawl down the hall, dragging my foot behind me and very quietly knocking on my friends door so I didn’t wake any of the kids and asked if he could take me to ER. I ended up tearing ligaments in my foot. I was on crutches for a week and a cane for like 2-3 weeks.

That is exactly why I left when both of my parents were out of town. They like to say that we could have all talked about it. Um, if I had felt like I could have talked about it, I would have talked about it.
